title: Airtable
content:
## Overview

Airtable is a cloud collaboration platform that combines the simplicity of a spreadsheet with the power of a database. Connect your Emergent app to Airtable to read, write, and sync data across bases, tables, and views.

<Note>
You'll need an Airtable account and a personal access token to complete this integration. Free Airtable accounts support basic API access.
</Note>

## When to use Airtable

Airtable works well for:

- **Content management** — Store blog posts, FAQs, or marketing copy that non-technical teammates can edit
- **Product catalogs** — Sync inventory, pricing, or feature flags from a structured base
- **User-generated data** — Collect form submissions, feature requests, or survey responses
- **Collaboration** — Share data with stakeholders who prefer a visual spreadsheet interface over raw JSON

If you need high-throughput transactional storage or complex relational queries, consider using the [MongoDB integration](/database-mongodb) instead.

## Before you begin

<Steps>
<Step title="Create or identify an Airtable base">
Log in to [Airtable](https://airtable.com) and create a new base (or locate an existing one). Note the base ID — it appears in the URL when you open the base:

```
https://airtable.com/appXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/...
                      ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
                         base ID
```
</Step>

<Step title="Generate a personal access token">
1. Go to [https://airtable.com/create/tokens](https://airtable.com/create/tokens)
2. Click **Create new token**
3. Give it a descriptive name (e.g., "Emergent integration")
4. Under **Scopes**, select:
   - `data.records:read` (to read records)
   - `data.records:write` (to create/update records)
   - `schema.bases:read` (to list tables and fields)
5. Under **Access**, choose the specific base(s) this token can access
6. Click **Create token** and copy the token immediately — you won't see it again
</Step>
</Steps>

<Warning title="Keep your token secure">
Treat your Airtable personal access token like a password. Anyone with this token can read or modify data in the bases you granted access to.
</Warning>

## Connect Airtable to Emergent

<Steps>
<Step title="Open the integrations panel">
In the Emergent workspace, click **Integrations** in the left sidebar (or press `I`).
</Step>

<Step title="Add Airtable">
Scroll to **Media & productivity** and click **Airtable**. Click **Connect**.
</Step>

<Step title="Paste your token">
In the **Personal Access Token** field, paste the token you generated. Click **Save**.
</Step>

<Step title="Verify the connection">
Emergent will test the token by fetching your account metadata. If successful, you'll see a green checkmark and "Connected" status.
</Step>
</Steps>

## Using Airtable in your app

Once connected, you can describe Airtable operations in chat and the AI agents will generate the integration code.

### Example prompts

<CardGroup cols={2}>
<Card title="Read records" icon="table">
"Fetch all records from the 'Products' table in my Airtable base and display them as cards."
</Card>
<Card title="Create a record" icon="plus">
"When the user submits this form, create a new record in the 'Leads' table with their name and email."
</Card>
<Card title="Update a record" icon="pencil">
"Add a button that marks a task as complete by updating the 'Status' field in Airtable."
</Card>
<Card title="Filter & sort" icon="filter">
"Show only records where 'Published' is true, sorted by 'Date' descending."
</Card>
</CardGroup>

### Common patterns

<Tabs>
<Tab title="Read & display">
Fetch records from a table and render them in your UI:

```javascript
// The AI agent will generate code similar to:
const records = await airtable.base('appXXXXXX').table('Products').select().all();
const products = records.map(r => ({ id: r.id, ...r.fields }));
```

Describe the desired UI (grid, list, table) and the agent will map the fields to components.
</Tab>

<Tab title="Create records">
Capture user input and write it to Airtable:

```javascript
await airtable.base('appXXXXXX').table('Leads').create({
  Name: formData.name,
  Email: formData.email,
  Source: 'Website form'
});
```

The agent infers field names from your Airtable schema when you describe the operation.
</Tab>

<Tab title="Update records">
Modify existing records by ID:

```javascript
await airtable.base('appXXXXXX').table('Tasks').update(recordId, {
  Status: 'Complete',
  CompletedAt: new Date().toISOString()
});
```

Describe the trigger (button click, form submit) and the fields to change.
</Tab>
</Tabs>

## Field types & mapping

Airtable supports many field types. The AI agent automatically maps them to JavaScript values:

| Airtable field type | JavaScript type | Notes |
|---------------------|----------------|-------|
| Single line text    | `string`       | Plain text |
| Long text           | `string`       | Multi-line, markdown supported |
| Number              | `number`       | Integer or decimal |
| Checkbox            | `boolean`      | `true` / `false` |
| Single select       | `string`       | One option from a predefined list |
| Multiple select     | `string[]`     | Array of selected options |
| Date                | `string`       | ISO 8601 format (`YYYY-MM-DD`) |
| Attachment          | `object[]`     | Array of `{ url, filename, ... }` |
| Link to another record | `string[]`  | Array of linked record IDs |

<Info>
When you describe a field in chat (e.g., "the product's price"), the agent inspects your Airtable schema and uses the correct field name and type.
</Info>

## Best practices

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="Use views to pre-filter data">
Create an Airtable view with filters and sorting, then fetch from that view by name. This reduces API overhead and keeps complex logic in Airtable's UI.

```javascript
.table('Products').select({ view: 'Published items' })
```
</Accordion>

<Accordion title="Cache frequently read data">
If a table changes infrequently (e.g., a settings table), cache the results in your app state and refresh periodically rather than fetching on every page load.
</Accordion>

<Accordion title="Handle rate limits gracefully">
Airtable's API is rate-limited (5 requests per second per base). For high-traffic apps, batch operations or use a background sync pattern. Describe the requirement in chat and the agent will implement retry logic.
</Accordion>

<Accordion title="Validate before writing">
Always validate user input before creating or updating records. The agent will add validation when you describe constraints (e.g., "email must be valid," "price must be positive").
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

## Troubleshooting

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="'Invalid token' or 403 errors">
**Cause:** The personal access token is missing, expired, or lacks the required scopes.

**Solution:**
1. Regenerate the token at [https://airtable.com/create/tokens](https://airtable.com/create/tokens)
2. Ensure you selected `data.records:read`, `data.records:write`, and `schema.bases:read`
3. Confirm the token has access to the specific base
4. Re-enter the token in Emergent's integrations panel
</Accordion>

<Accordion title="'Table not found' errors">
**Cause:** The table name in your code doesn't match the table name in Airtable (names are case-sensitive).

**Solution:** Double-check the table name in Airtable. In chat, say "use the exact table name 'Products'" to ensure the agent uses the correct casing.
</Accordion>

<Accordion title="Records missing expected fields">
**Cause:** Empty fields are omitted from the API response by default.

**Solution:** The agent handles this automatically by using optional chaining (`record.fields.FieldName ?? defaultValue`). Describe default values in chat if needed.
</Accordion>

<Accordion title="Attachment URLs expire">
**Cause:** Airtable attachment URLs are temporary and expire after a few hours.

**Solution:** Download and re-host attachments in your app's storage, or fetch fresh URLs each time. Describe the desired behavior and the agent will implement it.
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

## Limits & pricing

- **Free plan:** 1,200 records per base, 2 GB attachment storage per base, 5 requests/second API rate limit
- **Paid plans:** Higher record limits, longer revision history, and advanced features

Check [Airtable's pricing page](https://airtable.com/pricing) for current details. Emergent does not charge extra for Airtable integrations.
